name: title
label: Title
help_text: Mantener como Heading 3. El texto en negrita (strong) se muestra con el acento de color/gradiente.

name: intro
label: Intro
help_text: Texto de apoyo bajo el título (navy, estilo Body). Ancho máximo ~600px: el salto de línea lo da el ancho, no uses saltos manuales.
default: Pair any package with high-traffic moments that keep your brand in mind and in conversation.

name: items
label: Add-on cards
help_text: Una card por add-on. Grid de 3 columnas en desktop, 2 en tablet (1024px o menos) y 1 en mobile (767px o menos).

children.name: title
children.label: Title
children.help_text: Nombre del add-on. Texto en negrita navy (no es un encabezado).

children.name: icon_type
children.label: Icon source
children.help_text: Choose the built-in + or a decorative icon from HubSpot's library for this card.

children.name: price
children.label: Price
children.help_text: Se muestra al pie de la card, en negrita navy. Ej.: "$3,000 Investment".

children.name: cta
children.label: CTA (optional)
children.help_text: HubSpot CTA opcional (se configura en Marketing > CTAs). El Figma no muestra CTA en estas cards: déjalo vacío y no se renderiza nada.

children.name: cta_style
children.label: CTA style
children.help_text: Aplica a CTAs legacy. Los CTAs actuales conservan el diseño configurado en HubSpot.

default.title: Lounge Bar Sponsor
default.description: Host the bar where the best evening conversations happen, with your logo on signage.

default.title: Tote Sponsor
default.description: Your logo on the tote every attendee receives at check-in and keeps to carry well beyond the event.

default.title: First Sip Sponsor
default.description: Fuel the morning. Your brand is the first thing sellers see as each day begins at coffee stations.

default.title: Food Station Sponsor
default.description: Branded signage where attendees naturally gather, an easy place to start a conversation.

default.title: Lanyards
default.description: Your logo on every name badge lanyard, present in every session, photo, and conversation.

default.title: Charging Station
default.description: Keep everyone powered up. Attendees return all day, giving your team built-in time to engage and start a new conversation.

name: anchor_id
label: Anchor ID
help_text: Opcional. ID de la sección para enlazar desde un CTA (ej. "add-ons" para #add-ons). Sin # ni espacios. Vacío = sin id.

children.name: spacing_desktop
children.label: Desktop spacing
children.help_text: Padding superior/inferior en desktop. Izquierda/derecha ocultos: el espaciado horizontal lo da .content-wrapper.

children.name: spacing_mobile
children.label: Mobile spacing
children.help_text: Padding superior/inferior en mobile (max-width: 767px), independiente del valor de desktop.

children.name: show_icons
children.label: Show icons
children.help_text: Shows each card's selected + or HubSpot icon in the upper-right corner.
